# The LÖVE 11 subset on the console

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_api_subset.lua from runtime/ and tools/api_subset_notes.lua. Do not edit:
     change the code or the notes and run `luajit tools/gen_api_subset.lua`. -->

Every LÖVE 11 function, method and callback the console runtime implements, taken from the
code (`runtime/lua/boot.lua`, `runtime/lua/input.lua`, `runtime/l360_gfx.c`). **Anything not
listed here does not exist on the console**: calling it there logs `[missing] <name>` once and
does nothing (it returns nil).

- **full**: behaves as in LÖVE 11 for a 2D game.
- **partial**: works within the limit given.
- **stub**: can be called, does nothing useful (it may return a fixed value).

Now: 223 full, 64 partial, 50 stub.

## Checking a game on PC: tools/compat_check.lua

Copy `tools/compat_check.lua` and `tools/api_subset_data.lua` into the game folder and require
the first one at the top of `main.lua`, before anything else:

```lua
local compat = require("compat_check")   -- prints to the console window
-- compat.install({ file = "compat_check.txt" })   -- optional: also append to that file in the save folder
```

Play the game on official LÖVE 11.x. It runs exactly as before; each time it calls something
the console does not have, a line is printed, once per name:

```
[compat] love.graphics.arc: not on the console (missing)
[compat] love.graphics.setBlendMode: "multiply" is drawn as "alpha" on the console (only "alpha" and "add")
[compat] love.keypressed: the console never calls it (There is no keyboard...)
```

- **missing**: the function, method or module is not in this list.
- **stub**: it is here as a stub.
- **limit**: a partial function called in a way the console does not support, where that is
  cheap to see from the arguments (the *Checked* notes below say which). Other limits are not
  checked: read the table.
- **callback**: the game defines a callback the console never calls.

`compat.report()` prints the totals and every line again (call it from `love.quit`, for
example) and returns the counts. The module only wraps functions (the calls, arguments,
results and errors pass through unchanged), does nothing if it is not required, and does
nothing on the console, so the `require` can stay in. If it is required from `conf.lua`, where
most modules are not loaded yet, call `compat.install()` again at the top of `main.lua`.
Only what the game actually calls while it is played is seen.

## Regenerating this file

```
luajit tools/gen_api_subset.lua           # writes docs/API_SUBSET.md and tools/api_subset_data.lua
luajit tools/gen_api_subset.lua --check   # fails if they are out of date
```

The names come from the code; the limits, and what counts as a stub or as missing, are written
by hand in `tools/api_subset_notes.lua`. A function added to the runtime shows up as **full**
until it has a note there.

## love.filesystem

Reading looks in the save folder first and then in the game folder, as in LÖVE. Everything written goes to the game's save folder (`save_dir` in game.lua), two slots per file.

| Function | Status | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| `love.filesystem.append` | partial | Rewrites the whole file. |
| `love.filesystem.createDirectory` | partial | Remembered for this run only; nothing is created on disk. |
| `love.filesystem.getDirectoryItems` | partial | The game folder and what was saved in this run: saves of earlier runs are not listed. |
| `love.filesystem.getIdentity` | full |  |
| `love.filesystem.getInfo` | partial | `modtime` is always 0; no table argument. |
| `love.filesystem.getSaveDirectory` | full |  |
| `love.filesystem.getSource` | partial | Always `"."`. |
| `love.filesystem.getSourceBaseDirectory` | partial | Always `"."`. |
| `love.filesystem.isFused` | full |  |
| `love.filesystem.load` | partial | Text chunks only; no mode argument. |
| `love.filesystem.read` | partial | The whole file as a string. Checked: a container type or a size. |
| `love.filesystem.remove` | partial | Save files and folders made in this run. |
| `love.filesystem.setIdentity` | partial | Only changes what `getIdentity` answers; the save folder is game.lua's. |
| `love.filesystem.write` | partial | The whole string; no size argument. Subfolders are flattened into the file name. |

Commonly used and **missing**: `newFile`, `lines`, `newFileData`, `mount`, `unmount`, `exists` (LÖVE 0.10: use `getInfo`), `isFile` (LÖVE 0.10), `isDirectory` (LÖVE 0.10), `getSize` (LÖVE 0.10), `getLastModified` (LÖVE 0.10), `getRealDirectory`, `getWorkingDirectory`, `getUserDirectory`, `getAppdataDirectory`, `setRequirePath`, `getRequirePath`, `setSymlinksEnabled`.

## love.event

The console has its own frame loop: there is no event queue and `love.run` is not used.

| Function | Status | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| `love.event.clear` | stub | Nothing to clear. |
| `love.event.poll` | stub | An iterator that ends at once. |
| `love.event.pump` | stub | Nothing to pump. |
| `love.event.push` | partial | Only `"quit"`. Checked: another event. |
| `love.event.quit` | partial | Leaves the game after `love.quit`. No exit status. Checked: `"restart"`. |

Commonly used and **missing**: `wait`.

## love.thread

There are no real threads: a thread is a coroutine on the main thread, resumed once per frame.

| Function | Status | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| `love.thread.getChannel` | full |  |
| `love.thread.newChannel` | full |  |
| `love.thread.newThread` | partial | A coroutine on the main thread: it must give the turn back with `Channel:demand` or `love.timer.sleep`, or the game stops. Its code cannot `require("love.*")` modules of its own: it shares them. |

Commonly used and **missing**: .

### Thread

| Method | Status | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| `Thread:getError` | full |  |
| `Thread:isRunning` | full |  |
| `Thread:release` | full |  |
| `Thread:start` | full |  |
| `Thread:wait` | stub | Returns at once: the thread only runs between frames. |

Commonly used and **missing**: `type`.

### Channel

At most 256 values per channel; more are dropped.

| Method | Status | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| `Channel:clear` | full |  |
| `Channel:demand` | partial | No timeout. In a thread it waits one frame and may then answer nil; on the main thread it never waits. |
| `Channel:getCount` | full |  |
| `Channel:peek` | full |  |
| `Channel:pop` | full |  |
| `Channel:push` | full |  |
| `Channel:supply` | partial | Does not wait for the value to be taken. |

Commonly used and **missing**: `performAtomic`, `hasRead`.

## Modules that do not exist

| Module | |
|---|---|
| `love.font` | No Rasterizer or GlyphData; fonts come from `love.graphics.newFont`. |
| `love.image` | No ImageData: no pixel access, no `newImageData`, no images made in code. |
| `love.physics` | No Box2D. Use a Lua library (bump.lua, HC...) or your own collisions. |
| `love.video` | No video playback. |
